event_info.event_description: Analyze for disclosures on global pandemic risks. Look for corporate language discussing widespread impacts like supply chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote work transitions, and fundamental shifts in consumer demand.

holistic_analysis: The provided document contains only boilerplate cross-references to other sections of the Annual Report (“MD&A – Risk Factors” and various Notes) and does not include any substantive language that discusses, acknowledges, or quantifies risks related to the COVID-19 pandemic. Because there are no sentences describing supply-chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote-work transitions, or changes in consumer demand, there is no direct or indirect evidence to score. Accordingly, under the methodology—and consistent with the Time Decay Principle—no risk indicators specific to the pandemic can be extracted from this excerpt.
